story: Đêm Trung thu, bé Tí làm một chiếc đèn ông sao bằng giấy kiếng đỏ nhưng nến cứ tắt vì gió. Các bạn trong xóm rước đèn đi qua, chỉ mình Tí đứng ở hiên nhà. Ông nội lặng lẽ mang ra chiếc chụp đèn cũ bằng tre của ông ngày bé, lắp vào che gió. Ngọn nến sáng trở lại. Tí chạy theo đoàn rước đèn dưới trăng tròn, ông đứng ở cổng mỉm cười.

modelNotes: vision: no Nemotron Omni model in the catalog, so the critic runs in TEXT mode (SVG + render stats).

bible.title: Đèn Ông Sao Của Tí
bible.logline: Đêm Trung thu, một chiếc đèn giấy tắt nến tìm lại ánh sáng nhờ che tre giàu của ông nội, bé Tí vui chạy theo đoàn rước đèn dưới trăng tròn.

cast.name: Tí
cast.look: Small boy, round cheeks, short-sleeved shirt and shorts, bare feet. Holds a five-point red cellophane star lantern with a tiny paper tail fluttering at one tip.

cast.name: Ông nội
cast.look: Elderly man, slightly stooped, wearing faded áo bà ba, cloth sandals. Gentle crescent eyes. Carries a smooth bamboo walking stick with a carved knot near the handle.

cast.name: Đèn ông sao
cast.look: Five-point star made of red cellophane paper over thin bamboo ribs, open base for a tealight candle. One point has a 3 cm paper tail. Candle flame visible inside.

cast.name: Che đèn tre
cast.look: Old woven bamboo cylinder, 18 cm tall, 12 cm diameter, charred rim at top and bottom. Fits snugly over the star lantern. Subtle diagonal weave pattern.

cast.name: Hiên nhà
cast.look: Raised wooden floor, low railing with turned balusters. A clothesline holds two shirts fluttering. Paper-cut shadow patterns from railing fall across floorboards.

cast.name: Ngõ xóm
cast.look: Narrow lane between tiled roofs, mossy brick paving. Paper lanterns of various shapes (carp, rabbit, star) glow from both sides. Overhead wires droop.

cast.name: Trăng tròn
cast.look: Large perfect circle, soft off-white with faint paper fiber texture. Halo of pale gold. Casts long paper-cut shadows of trees and rooftops.

shots.description: Tí stands on the porch railing holding the red star lantern; the candle gutters and dies as a gust lifts the hanging shirts. Night, faint lantern glow on his face.
shots.speaker: ti

shots.description: Extreme close-up of the star lantern: red cellophane walls glow then darken, the wick curls in a thin smoke ribbon. Night, last candle glow.
A troop of children parades down the alley, lanterns swaying — carp, rabbit, stars — their laughter rippling. Golden dusk turning to night, lantern light pooling on wet bricks.
shots.dialogue: Đi đi đèn ông sao, rạng rạng ngõ xóm...
shots.speaker: Narrator

shots.description: Tí alone on the porch, shoulders slumped. Grandfather steps into frame from the shadows, offering the bamboo shade with both hands. Night, porch light warm on wood.
shots.speaker: grandfather

shots.description: Grandfather's weathered hands lower the bamboo cylinder over the star lantern; it seats with a soft click. The candle flares up, painting the weave gold. Night, warm glow.
Tí sprints down the alley, lantern high, bamboo shade glowing like a tiny lighthouse. The full moon hangs huge above the rooftops. Night, moonlight silver on bricks.
shots.speaker: ti

shots.description: Grandfather leans on the gate post, smiling, watching Tí merge into the lantern river under the moon. Long paper-cut shadows stretch across the lane. Night, moonlight.
shots.dialogue: Vui thì mới là Trung thu.
shots.speaker: Narrator
